overviewHtml:
Luxury Holiday in Nepal - 7 Days

We are the Nepal Unique Treks family, and we are happy to share with you a Luxury Holiday in Nepal at a reasonable cost and itinerary for 2026/2027. We are the responsible travel agency in Nepal who have organized many successful holidays in Nepal. Our clients' satisfaction, success, and safety are our goals. We organize the best quality Trekking, Tours, Climbing, and many more tourism activities in Kathmandu, Nepal. According to clients' Inquiries, we organize the best Luxury Holidays in Nepal.

During this Holiday, we will see a scenic Mountain flight, an Everest flight experience, UNESCO World Heritage sites, Local culture, religion, the Himalayan people's lifestyle, magnificent panoramic Mountain views, and the historical cities of Kathmandu and Pokhara. Nepal is a Himalayan country where you can explore the world's tallest snow peak, Mt. Everest, and many more climbed mountains. Trekking and Climbing are popular destinations in the world.

In earlier times, Nepal organized only trekking and climbing for adventure lovers, but at the moment, we do have beautiful structures that offer luxury with beautiful nature. Many international, 5-star hotel services arrived in Nepal, which helped us to organize the best Luxury Holiday in Nepal. During this Luxury Holiday, you may visit. We will provide you with an English-speaking and any language-speaking responsible tour guide who helps you explore part of Nepal, and a comfortable private vehicle with responsible drivers from the end of your International airport departure.

Why Nepal Unique Treks for Nepal Holiday

In 2004, I started my job as a trekking guide assistant in the tourism industry. After a few years of trekking experience, I loved my job, and then I saw the future in Tourism, which is why I continuously worked and promoted my knowledge by learning mountaineering and tour guiding.

On 26 August 2014 officially registered as a travel company so since that day we have provided the best quality service to my clients as a Travel and tour Organizer, We are associated with the Nepal Mountaineering Association of Nepal (NMA) Trekking Agency Association of Nepal (TAAN), Nepal Tourism Board (NTB), Nepal Association of Tour and Travel Agent ( NATTA), Himalayan Risqué Association of Nepal (HRA), Kathmandu Environmental Education Project (KEEP) and International Porters Protection Group (IPPG), Gurung Tourism Entrepreneurs' Association, Nepal (GTEAN)

All our clients are happy with our Service and teamwork, and that's why Nepal Unique Treks is the best for a Nepal Holiday.

How long is the Best Luxury Holiday in Nepal?

We provide 7 days of the Best Luxury Holiday in Nepal. If you are more interested in exploring Nepal, then we can customize the itinerary to your plan and interests. In this package, you can explore the Everest Mountain Flight, Kathmandu Valley Sightseeing, the UNESCO World Heritage site, Nagarkot stay, flight to Pokhara, Pokhara Valley sightseeing, and the Sarangkot viewpoint. These are the major destinations on this tour.

What types of accommodations during the Luxury Holiday in Nepal?

During this tour, we will provide 4-star to 5-star premium luxury hotels in Nagarkot, Kathmandu, and Pokhara, depending on your choice and demand. Which is why we selected hotels with luxury and authentic Nepalese hospitality.

Are lunch and dinner included in this tour package?

Every Morning, a premium Breakfast is included in your Hotel. But Lunch and dinner are of your choice in Kathmandu and Pokhara. On the Last Day, Nepal Unique Treks will invite you for a special farewell dinner in Kathmandu, which is included in the package.

Is travel insurance necessary for this tour?

Nepal Unique Treks highly recommends buying travel insurance that covers Baggage loss, accidents, Mountain sickness, or any natural disaster, missing your international flight, and, if needed, emergency air ambulance and Hospital medication.

What is the best time for this Tour?

All the years and seasons are best for the Nepal Holiday, but we recommend to our clients the spring season from March to May and the autumn season from late September to December. During these sessions, the blue skies and snow peaks can be seen from far away.

itinerary.title: Welcome in Tribhuvan International Airport 1345m. 6.5 km drive to Hotel
itinerary.description: Nepal Unique Treks Team is ready at the Airport for your Welcome, Then drive to the Hotel, which takes 30 m from the International Airport. Check-in Hotel with welcome drinks, We will discuss the Best Luxury Holiday in Nepal & complete the official agriment. Overnight sleep in a Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Valley Sightseeing with Private Guide 5/6 hrs., 1345m
itinerary.description: Breakfast in Hotel then meeting with Tour guide and Start Kathmandu Valley Tours. The Day starts from Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple), The Guide will explain to you about the Temple, Pagoda, Religion, Locle culture, Heritage sites of Nepal, and Nepali people's lifestyle, Then a Contineusly tour of Bouddhanath Stupa, Pashupatinath (Hindu Temple) Patan Durbar Squire. Along the way, you will enjoy and test Nepali foods.

itinerary.title: The Everest Mountain Flight, Drive to Nagarkot 2175m, 2 hrs.
itinerary.description: Early Morning 5 am drive to Kathmandu Domestic Airport. Check-in Airport for the Mountain flight then the airline crew will help you during the Mountain flight. 45 m Mountain flight will show you a Magnificent panoramic view of Mt Everest. Over thirty snowcapped mountains include Everest, Nuptse, Lhotse, Choyou, Makalu, Pumori, Amadablam, and Others. After a beautiful mountain flight drive back to the Hotel and have breakfast. Take a rest and drive to Patan Durbar Squire, Bhaktapur Durbar Squire, Exploring UNESCO World Heritage sites then enjoy the Lunch in Bhaktapur. You have a joyful time at these two sightseeing places and learn many things about Nepal. The Day continuously drives to Nagarkot, which takes 1 hour from Bhaktapur. Check-in at Hotel Country Villa in Nagarkot, They will welcome you with hot drinks because Nagarkot is Cold and is Situated at 2175m from Sea level. Nagarkot is the best place for a mountain view and also the best place for stressed people who need peace, In the evening you will see sunset views including Snow Mountain. Enjoy a delicious dinner in the Hotel, and sleep at Nagarkot in Hotel Country Villa.

itinerary.title: Flight to Pokhara International Airport 810m, 30 m Flight
itinerary.description: The morning will wake you with a stunning Sunset view and Panoramic Mountain view and enjoy the breakfast in Hotel. Naturally beautiful Nagarkot will give you some positive vibes to enjoy the tour package of Best Luxury Holiday in Nepal. After Breakfast drive to Kathmandu Domestic Airport and 30 m mountain flight to Pokhara. Our driver will take you to the Hotel after a 45 m drive. Check-in at Pokhara Hotel, then 5 m walk to the restaurant, where they make delicious food for Lunch. After Lunch, Our guide will brief you about Pokhara and their activities. The guide will take you to the Taal Barahi Temple by boat. then stroll around the lakeside. Hike back to the Hotel and relax. At 6:30 pm Hike to Lakeside and enjoy the dinner. Pokhara is best for a night Party ask with guide if you prefer Nepal Nightlife and clubbing parties. Overnight sleep at Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing in Pokhara Valley 810, 5/6 hrs.
itinerary.description: This morning you will see a surprising view of the Himalayas from Pokhara. More than 15 snow peaks you can see from Pokhara. After breakfast you will start Sightseeing, Our tour guide will help you to explore Pokhara and interact with their history, lifestyle, religion, and Culture. Tour Guide will bring you to see World Peace Stupa, Gupteswar Mahadev Cave, David Falls, and the International Mountain Museum. In the afternoon time drive back to the Hotel, and relax in the Hotel. The early Evening Guide will bring you to the restaurant and enjoy dinner, walk back to the Hotel for your luxurious stay. Overnight at Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Explore Nagarkot Sunrise Viewpoint, Flight to Kathmandu 30 Minute, 1345m
itinerary.description: Early Morning, a Tour guide will bring you to the Sarangkot Viewpoint 45 m drive from the Hotel. The dramatic Annapurna mountain view will surprise you with a stunning sunrise view. In Sarangkot the beautiful view makes your special morning. Our guide will order some hot tea and coffee. Spend your time till the sun makes bright lightning on Earth. Drive back to the Hotel and enjoy the time for breakfast. Manage your bags and put on doors. Hotel staff will collect the luggage and put it in the car. 45 m drive will arrive at Pokhara International Airport. The tour Guide will set the flight time and will share with you about the situation then 30 minute flights to Kathmandu. Arrive at Kathmandu Hotel and relax. If you like to explore Thamel yourself or with a guide you may spend time there shopping, Massage, and Having Coffee as you wish. In the evening, you will join with us for the celebration of a farewell dinner. Which is Organized by Nepal Unique Treks. Share your travel experience and teach by learning, Exchange the respect and you will be congratulated by the Nepal Unique Treks Team for your Successful and healthy Holiday in Nepal. If you wish to enjoy the nightlife in Kathmandu it will be the perfect time and place. but we recommend going with our guide, who help you joyful Holiday in Nepal.

itinerary.title: Departure from Hotel for your International Flight 1345m.
itinerary.description: Today is the last day in Nepal. After breakfast, Nepal Unique Treks will help you to drop off at the International Airport. Before That, you have time to walk around Thamel and near Your Hotel. You have time to collect some handicrafts from Nepal as a gift for your family and friends. Three Hours before departure from Hotel then your flight schedule.
